findings.problem: The content check is off for the whole file docs/implementation-plan-v1.md, not for the one quote. The reason 'the plan must not be edited' is false: the plan is edited in this diff (389ed23) and is the most edited normative file. No test covers key material inside the allowlisted file. CODEOWNERS does not block the merge by the owner's decision.
findings.required_improvement: For allowlisted paths remove exactly the quoted fragment (backtick + header + backtick, built in code, not spelled out) once and scan the rest normally. Test: plan with the quote passes; plan with the quote plus another header or a header with a key body fails. Fix the reason text in CONTENT_ALLOWLIST and in reports/conformance/M0.json.

findings.problem: The only code owner is @dmitry-v-ko and PRs are opened under the same account (PR #1). GitHub never requests a review from the PR author, so step 5 ('dmitry-v-ko appears in Reviewers automatically') fails when done literally, and the CODEOWNERS half of AC-M0-03 cannot be observed in the owner's chosen setup. The contradiction between AC text and setup is not raised to the owner.
findings.required_improvement: State in the doc that with a single owner who is also the PR author no review request appears. Record the AC wording issue as an escalation to the owner in reports/conformance/M0.json instead of silently rewording.
